### `agents-disrupt-knowledge-gatekeepers`: Agents disrupt knowledge gatekeepers (candidate)

- **Distinct claim:** Agentic AI will displace incumbents that monetize gatekept institutional knowledge.
- **Mechanism:** Model access is democratized while incumbents cannot tear down their UIs and business models to pivot, so agent-native entrants take share.
- **Scope:** Law, medicine and personal finance, over roughly the next decade, as the source frames it.
- **Suggested by:** `67bc8af5f66a` from [Mignano argues agentic AI will reorganize markets the way internet and then mobile/cloud did, hitting incumbents that ca](https://x.com/mignano/status/2111566624855560200) by mignano, 2026-10-17; proposed by box 2026-10-18
- **Considered `robotaxi-value-capture`:** That thesis is about who captures driverless ride-hailing profits; this claim is about agents displacing knowledge-gatekeeping incumbents in law, medicine and personal finance.
- **Considered `us-mass-timber-adoption`:** That thesis concerns building-code changes for mass timber, which is unrelated to AI agents disrupting incumbent business models.
- **Considered `sunbelt-heartland-real-estate`:** That thesis is about regional real-estate demand shifts, not about AI agents displacing knowledge businesses.
- **Considered `buy-after-momentum-capitulation`:** That thesis is a trading pattern about exhausted momentum selling, not a structural claim about which industries agents disrupt.
- **Considered `private-credit-hidden-risk`:** That thesis is about appraisal-based marks hiding private-credit risk, not about agent-driven disruption of incumbents.
